out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A bottle of hand sanitizer was stored on a food prep table.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. Hand sanitizer is not be necessary in a permitted food establishment as handwashing is required. The PIC moved the hand sanitizer during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: The main handwashing sink in the food prep area was not working due to a leak. The PIC was actively correcting the issue and another handsink was available for staff to use.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. Correct the hand sink problem as soon as possible or within 10 days. A follow-up is required for this.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: turkey meatloaf cooked yesterday was 44ºF in the refrigerator today.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The food was not cooled properly and was discarded by the PIC during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. The certified food manager was not present when the inspection started.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. The CFM arrived during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a container of white rice in the walk-in was 70F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The container of rice was discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. In the basement, a bottle of rodent repellant was stored with single service items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The person in charge moved the rodent repellant to another location. Pest control chemicals should only be applied by licensed pest control operators.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Observed the back exit door is in need of proper weather stripes.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO INSTALL PROPER WEATHER STRIPS TO CLOSE THE GAPS ON THE BOTTOM AND SIDES OF THE BACK EXIT DOOR. THE MANAGER SPOKE WITH THE FACILITY MAINTENANCE STAFF TO HAVE IT FIXED DURING INSPECTION. THIS ITEM WILL BE VERIFIED DURING NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over 3-VAT SINK SANITIZER STATION AND CLEAN DISH DRAIN BOARD SIDE where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. THE DEVICE WAS RELOCATED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: THIN FILMS AT THE DOUGH MIXTURE.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO REMOVE THE THIN FILM DURING INSPECTION. ILIFF NURSING AND REHAB (Inspection Date: 06/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: 3-VAT SINK, BEVERAGE AREA’S TABLES
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO CAULK THE 3-VAT SINK, AND TABLES AT THE BEVERAGE STATION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for general dish washing area to hold sanitizer bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO REMOVE THE MILK CRATES FROM THE FACILITY.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: DRAIN AT THE 3-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO INCREASE CLEANING THE DRAINS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the ICE MACHINE AND JUICE/SODA CARBONATOR are not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. - THE MOP SINK WAS CONNECTED WITH A SPRAY HOSE ON THE SPLITTER .
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. PROVIDE A PROPER BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE AT THE ICE MACHINE AND JUICE/SODA MACHINE WITHIN 2 DAYS. NOTE: THE SPRAY HOSE AT THE MOP SINK WAS DISCONNECTED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: THE SELF CLOSING DEVICE IS IN NEED OF REPAIR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. REPAIR THE SELF-CLOSING DEVICE.

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PROVIDE COVER FOR THE TRASH CAN.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the following areas are not maintained in good repair: - Basement dry food storage area ceiling with hole - Basement dry storage ceiling has vegetation (vine) growing inside - Floor tile under the 3-vat sink properly - Floor tile near 3-vat sink - hand sink basin crack
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. THE MANAGER COMMUNICATED THESE ITEMS TO THE MAINTENANCE TEAM AND THE FACILITY OPERATOR TO HAVE IT ADDRESSED. THESE ITEMS WILL BE VERIFIED DURING NECT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the MOP SINK ARE is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of excess ice at base: Ice build-up noted inside the upright freezer located next to the back entrance to the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of ice and other residue.
